title: Alliance outreach — daily docket
content:
Notes to self / quick docket - Samira (03/12)

Top priority (today):
- 10:00 sync w/ Evan — confirm onboarding timeline for OrbitalAI (partner).
- Ship onboarding email draft + SSO instructions by EOD. (use template: confluence:ALLIANCES-234 -> onboarding-template)

Quick checklist for OrbitalAI integration:
- [ ] API key created in staging (Evan) — verify key perms: embeddings, chat, and restricted export.
- [ ] Callback URL / webhook pattern: need signed payloads + timestamp. TODO: ask infra about HMAC secret rotation window.
- [ ] Rate limits: propose 600rpm burst, sustained 200rpm (discuss w/ infra SRE).
- [ ] Example payloads: attach minimal chat + system prompt + metadata. Add sample responses w/ streaming enabled.
- [ ] Billing plan: map to marketplace sku 'partner-basic-v2' and note discounts for 6mo commit.
- [ ] Security: PII flow doc for OrbitalAI use-case; flag for privacy review if they plan to send customer identifiers.

Integration notes / gotchas seen with similar partners:
- Some partners try to POST large conversation history — recommend client-side prefix trimming and server-side max tokens enforcement.
- KV cache interacts badly with streaming if they re-initiate session ids incorrectly. Add guidance in integration FAQ.
- We need to include model fallback policy in onboarding (default to smaller quantized instance if high load).

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal needs to confirm DP/DSA language for EU customers (reach out: @legal, ticket LEG-109).
- OrbitalAI asked about dedicated capacity for heavy batch embedding jobs — need ops estimate and pricing delta. (JIRA-5213).
- Do we allow partner to use our hosted eval harness for initial QA? Confirm limits.

Customer communications (draft points):
- "Next steps: staging API key, sample payloads, run 3 smoke tests, schedule 30-min checklist call"
- Attach quickstart link and 'common pitfalls' note.

Micro-tasks (today / next 48h):
- Draft email + SSO bullet list (Samira) — EOD
- Add streaming example to integration doc (Lina) — by 03/14
- Confirm rate limit proposal with SRE (Evan) — ASAP
- Create PR for onboarding page updates (branch: feat/alliances-orbital) — link to PR after creation

Reflection / tactical ideas:
- Consider adding a single-page ‘partner quickstart’ that folds SSO, webhooks, rate limits, and test payloads — reduces back-and-forth.
- Could offer a 30-day trial of Dedicated credits for partners with high embedding needs to accelerate proof-of-value. Note: needs finance sign-off.

End-of-day quick log (to fill later):
- Did I send onboarding email? [ ]
- Did I get API key created in staging? [ ]
- Follow-ups scheduled? [ ]

---
Random shorthand / reminders:
- Check git PR template: ensure 'partner-impact' tag present.
- Add one-liner to partner dashboard about SLO expectations for marketplace listings.
- Follow up with product-ops for SKU mapping (product-ops@redwood).

(Leave this doc as informal scratch — will extract polished checklist into confluence once stable.)
